extension.summary: Sync Kodi favourites.xml with cloud storage
extension.description: Synchronise Kodi favourites across devices using WebDAV, S3, SFTP, SMB/NAS, NFS, or local paths. Supports bidirectional merge, scheduled sync, and conflict resolution.
extension.news: v1.0.74.3: Switched to standard Kodi dialog UI (removed custom WindowXML styling). Uses native dialog.select() for standard Kodi appearance. v1.0.74.2: UI VISIBILITY FIX - Added button textures, uses Kodi's standard color scheme (removed forced colors) v1.0.74.1: CRITICAL BUGFIX - Fixed addon ID error when opening Manage Profiles from Settings, removed option="close" to keep Settings open v1.0.74: WindowXML UI reliability improvements - added 720p support, detailed error logging, explicit error messages
